title_en: Slide to Success in New Drift Races with 2X Rewards - Rockstar Games
excerpt_en: The sound of squealing tires and the acrid smell of smoking-hot rubber — the streets of Los Santos and Blaine County are being taken over by drift-happy racers. Slide your way to victory around three new Drift Races in GTA Online.
